nodes.bdb: Menahem = "comforter" son of Gadi and king of the northern kingdom of Israel; slew the usurper Shallum to ascend the throne and reigned for ten years; contemporary with prophets Hosea and Amos

nodes.g: Pekahiah = "Jehovah sees" son of king Menahem of the northern kingdom of Israel…
